```{r}
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r}

input_dir <- readline(
  prompt = "Enter the path to the directory containing rsem_counts.txt and sample_info.csv: "
)

counts_file <- file.path(input_dir, "rsem_counts.txt")
metadata_file <- file.path(input_dir, "sample_info.csv")

if (!file.exists(counts_file)) {
  stop("Could not find: ", counts_file)
}

if (!file.exists(metadata_file)) {
  stop("Could not find: ", metadata_file)
}

# Read RSEM counts
raw_counts <- read.table(
  counts_file,
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Clean sample names
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("\\.genes\\.results", "", colnames(raw_counts))
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("-", ".", colnames(raw_counts))
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("_$", "", colnames(raw_counts))

# Round counts
counts_data <- round(raw_counts)

# Read sample metadata
colData <- read.csv(
  metadata_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  row.names = 1
)

# Check that all count-matrix samples have metadata
all(colnames(counts_data) %in% rownames(colData))

```
